<thought>We need to determine the number of CH₃ (methyl) groups in the unknown sample. The best approach is to retrieve the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample (no arguments needed) and count the distinct carbon signals in the typical methyl region (≈10–30 ppm). This will give the number of methyl carbons, which equals the number of CH₃ groups.</thought>
